facts.statement: After reset receiver and transmitter FIFOs and shift registers are cleared and Divisor Latch is 0
facts.quote: The receiver and transmitter FIFOs are cleared.

facts.statement: After reset LCR is 8 bits no parity 1 stop bit and all interrupts disabled
facts.quote:
The Line Control Register is set to communication of 8 bits of data, no parity, 1
stop bit.

facts.statement: Initialization programs Divisor Latches MSB first LSB next with LCR bit7 DLAB gating
facts.quote: Set the Divisor Latches, MSB first, LSB next.

facts.statement: Baud rate equals Input Clock divided by Divisor divided by 16
facts.quote:
Remember that (Input Clock Speed)/(Divisor Latch value) = 16 x the communication
baud rate.

facts.statement: STX_PAD_O is DUT serial output and SRX_PAD_I is DUT serial input
facts.quote:
STX_PAD_O 1 Output The serial output signal
SRX_PAD_I 1 Input The serial input signal

facts.statement: Core uses WISHBONE SoC bus with 8-bit data bus
facts.quote: It has an 8-bit data bus for compatibility reason.

facts.statement: IIR bit0 0 means interrupt pending asserted with INT_O and 1 means no interrupt pending
facts.quote:
Bit 0 indicates that an interrupt is pending when it’s logic ‘0’. When it’s ‘1’ – no interrupt
is pending.

facts.statement: Modem Status interrupt source is CTS DSR RI or DCD change subject to IER enable
facts.quote: 0 0 0 4 th Modem Status CTS, DSR, RI or DCD.
